{{Quote|It will wipe out all life on an entire world within a matter of breaths.|Darth Maladi|<ref name="Legacy—War 5">[[Legacy — War 5|''Legacy — War'' 5]]</ref>}}
'''Omega Red''' was a deadly [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Bioweapon/Legends|toxin]] [[Sith alchemy/Legends|created]] by [[Darth Maladi]] around the year [[138 ABY]], based on the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] bio weapon [[Alpha Red (pathogen)|Alpha Red]]. Unlike the original strain, which was designed to target [[Yuuzhan Vong]], Omega Red was capable of killing any kind of species. She offered to reveal its secrets to the [[Empire-in-exile|exiled]] [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Roan Fel]] in exchange for safe haven and [[Cade Skywalker]]'s life. Roan Fel agreed to the deal in hopes of wiping out his rival, [[Darth Krayt]], but it turned out that the [[One Sith|Sith]] were immune to the toxin by design as a trick by Maladi and Krayt to wipe out [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. It was almost utilized by Fel until [[Antares Draco]] killed him to prevent it from being used.
